mechanics.name: Rapid Response
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever you become afflicted by Exhausted, Rapid Response reveals the Killer's Aura to you for 2 seconds. You can voluntarily trigger Exhausted by Fast Exiting a Locker; this applies Exhausted for 30/25/20 seconds by tier. Rapid Response cannot override an Exhausted effect that is already active.
activation: Become afflicted by Exhausted to reveal the Killer's Aura.
To voluntarily trigger the perk, Fast Exit a Locker while not already Exhausted.
Ends/deactivates when: Killer Aura reveal ends after 2 seconds.
Ends/deactivates when: The voluntary Exhausted effect lasts 30/25/20 seconds by tier; the perk cannot override an existing Exhausted effect.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (8.7.0): Introduced; no later material live balance change located in the official notes checked.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Gaining Exhausted reveals the Killer's Aura to you briefly, and a Fast Locker Exit can trigger tier-scaled Exhaustion voluntarily.
duration: Exhausted from Fast Exiting a Locker: 30/25/20 seconds by tier.
specialInteractions: The aura reveal also triggers when Exhausted is applied by another source; the perk cannot override an already active Exhausted status.

editorial.summary: Whenever you become Exhausted, briefly reveal the Killer's Aura; fast-exiting a Locker can voluntarily apply a short Exhausted timer.
useCases: Add a short Killer Aura read to Sprint Burst, Lithe, Dramaturgy, or other Exhaustion activations.
Use a fast Locker exit to trigger the information deliberately when you are not already Exhausted.
Pair with Vigil to shorten the voluntary Exhaustion tax.
counters: The Aura read lasts only two seconds.
Voluntarily becoming Exhausted can disable stronger chase perks when mistimed.
Fast Locker exits are noisy and require a Locker.
pros: Naturally piggybacks on popular Exhaustion perks.
Player can force a trigger through a Locker.
Vigil makes the short voluntary Exhaustion easier to manage.
cons: Can sabotage your own Exhaustion perk.
analysis: Rapid Response ranks this position because it can attach useful information to an event strong Survivor builds already create: becoming Exhausted. Sprint Burst, Dramaturgy, Lithe, and similar perks all become two-second Killer Aura triggers for free.

Two seconds is short but not meaningless. It can tell you which side of a structure the Killer chose after your burst or whether they abandoned chase entirely. Eyes of Belmont can extend that small window.

The Locker activation exists as a manual information button, but voluntarily inflicting Exhausted can be actively harmful when your real chase perk is ready. The user must understand which resource they are spending.
Rapid Response remains C because the information is brief and the manual trigger is awkward. It is best as garnish on an Exhaustion build rather than the reason the build exists.
editorial.verdict: A neat Exhaustion-information rider, not a core perk. Rapid Response adds two seconds of Killer vision to strong chase tools, but careless manual use can shut those tools off.
